funding_reviews.financial_summary:
Payment timing: Reimbursement; no project advance
Payment evidence checked 2026-11-11. The programme FAQ expressly says no advance funds for project implementation: partners pre-finance costs and claim reimbursement. A limited preparation-cost mechanism payable after subsidy-contract signature is a separate exception, not a general advance for restoration works or equipment. Partner cash flow and own co-finance remain necessary.

Total eligible project budget at most €2m, maximum 24 months. Indicative call allocation €20m (€16m Interreg and €4m national co-finance) is not a per-partner grant. Award/payment and partner cash flow require the programme manual and agreement.

funding_reviews.financial_summary:
Payment timing: Conditional advance available
Payment evidence checked 2026-11-11. The exact third-call model contract Article 7 offers advance choices of 20%, 25% or 30% of the contract value, fixed in the signed agreement, not automatically 30% of eligible project cost. Bank/state-aid registration and available EU funds govern timing. MA risk analysis can require guarantees, suspend transfer or reduce a partner’s advance to 10%; the lead partner distributes agreed shares. Later payments recover the advance. The contradictory OPEN heading/passed deadline remains unresolved.

EU contribution €920,000–€1.2m, fixed 92% eligible-cost contribution and 8% co-finance; published maximum total eligible cost €1,304,347.83. At least 50% of total eligible cost must be allocated as specified for Mediterranean partner countries. Grant-contract payment terms require confirmation.

funding_reviews.financial_summary:
Payment timing: Conditional advance · repayable aid
Payment evidence checked 2026-11-11. PID terms permit an advance up to 50% of awarded aid, capped at EUR 300,000 without additional guarantees beyond award conditions; up to 75% may be requested with guarantees for the increase. Payment follows loan-contract formalisation; other disbursements follow milestone conditions. The instrument remains partially repayable and may require financial guarantees; this is not a nonrepayable upfront grant or the Water4All CDTI route.

Minimum eligible budget €175,000. Partially repayable assistance; company contribution, repayment and incentive-effect conditions require financial review.
